switches.title: Switches
switches.intro: Choose what each switch on your radio does, as in Betaflight's Modes tab: a function is on while its channel is inside the green range. Flip a switch and watch its marker move.
switches.channelsHint: Flip a switch: its channel moves here.
switches.armWizard: Arm: {src}, as the setup wizard set it.
switches.armHint: To arm, the throttle must be low and the switch must go from off to on, as before.
switches.modeNone: No switch: you pick the mode in the simulator (M or the mode chip).
switches.modeMixed: Angle and Horizon are on different channels: set them in the ranges below.
switches.modePilot: Now: the mode you pick in the simulator
switches.ranges: Ranges, as in Betaflight (Acro when neither is on)
switches.functionsHint: Each time the switch enters its range, the function runs once, as if you pressed its key.
switches.full: Betaflight allows 20 ranges at most; this one was not added.
switches.buttonOnly: {src} reaches the computer only as on or off (EdgeTX sends channels 9 to 16 as buttons): use a range at the low or the high end.
switches.importHint: Paste the output of diff all from the Betaflight CLI. Its aux lines (the Modes tab) replace these switches: ARM, ANGLE and HORIZON.
switches.importSkipped: Not in the simulator, left out: {list}.
switches.importLinked: {mode} follows another mode in Betaflight; left out.
switches.importNone: No aux line with ARM, ANGLE or HORIZON in this text.
switches.importError: This text could not be read: {msg}
switches.reset: Back to the setup wizard's switches
switches.wizardBack: Back to what the setup wizard found. Save to keep it.
switches.fromWizard: This is what the setup wizard found. Nothing changes until you edit and save.
switches.edited: Your switches for this radio. They take effect when you save.
switches.recalNote: Recalibrating the radio starts a new setup: the wizard's arm and mode switch come back.
switches.checkNote: Arm and flight mode follow this radio's Switches (Controls, then Switches).
switches.settingsLine: Switches of {name}: which channel arms, sets the flight mode or runs rewind, record and more.
switches.settingsNoRadio: Radio switches (arm, flight mode, rewind, record…): connect your radio in Controls first.
switches.diffApplied: {name} now uses the switches from this diff (Controls, then Switches). Flip the arm switch off and on to arm.
switches.diffNoRadio: This diff also sets switches ({list}). Connect your radio in Controls, then paste the diff in Switches.
switches.importKept: Your function switches stay as they were: {list}.
switches.importDropped: Betaflight allows 20 ranges at most. Function ranges removed because they no longer fit: {n}.
switches.importNoArm: This diff sets no ARM, so the setup wizard's arm switch still arms.
switches.importNoMode: This diff sets no ANGLE or HORIZON, so the quad flies Acro. Here you pick the mode yourself (M or the mode chip).
